pairs.target: tǎ wéi dàohuò píng shí , nài lěi zhèngzài chī dìèrgè bǐng .
pairs.english: When Tavi reached the freight yard, Nerai was eating her second flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到货坪时，奈蕾正在吃第二个饼。

pairs.target: tā zuǐlǐsāi zhe dōngxī , zhī cháo pángbiān tái le tái xiàbā .
pairs.english: With her mouth full, she merely tilted her chin to one side.
pairs.hanzi: 她嘴里塞着东西，只朝旁边抬了抬下巴。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi shì jiào zìjǐ bāngmáng , shēnshǒu qù fú chēyuán ,
pairs.english: He thought she wanted help and reached to steady the cart shaft,
pairs.hanzi: 他以为是叫自己帮忙，伸手去扶车辕，

pairs.target: cái fāxiàn tā zhǐ de shì zhǐbāo lǐ shèngxià de bàngè .
pairs.english: only to discover she meant the half left in the paper wrapper.
pairs.hanzi: 才发现她指的是纸包里剩下的半个。

pairs.target: bǐng yǐjīng liáng le , cōng de wèidào hěn zhòng .
pairs.english: The bread was cold already and smelled strongly of scallions.
pairs.hanzi: 饼已经凉了，葱的味道很重。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāi xià yìxiǎokuài , bǎ qíyú de dìgěi mǐlā .
pairs.english: Tavi broke off a small piece and passed the rest to Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维掰下一小块，把其余的递给米拉。

pairs.target: yīwén zuìhòu gǎndào , shuō tāmen zǒu dé xiàng táokè ,
pairs.english: Iven arrived last, saying they walked as if they were skipping class,
pairs.hanzi: 伊文最后赶到，说他们走得像逃课，

pairs.target: jiéguǒ jiēguò bǐng , bǐ shuí dōu chī dé kuài .
pairs.english: then took the bread and ate faster than anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 结果接过饼，比谁都吃得快。

pairs.target: liǎngtiān qián zhuāng hǎo de xiāngzǐ yǐ bǎng zài chēshàng .
pairs.english: The boxes packed two days earlier were tied onto the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 两天前装好的箱子已绑在车上。

pairs.target: hè shīfu dūn zài lún biān lǐ shéng tóu , xié chuān dé hǎohǎo de .
pairs.english: Master He crouched beside a wheel, tidying rope ends, with his shoes properly on.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅蹲在轮边理绳头，鞋穿得好好的。

pairs.target: huò píng kào wài nà dào shíqiáng bǐ xuégōng de wéiqiáng ǎi ,
pairs.english: The yard's outer stone wall was lower than the academy wall.
pairs.hanzi: 货坪靠外那道石墙比学宫的围墙矮，

pairs.target: qiáng wài néng kànjiàn wānxiàqù de lù , lù xiàmiàn shì zǎoshì péngdǐng ,
pairs.english: Beyond it they could see the road curving downhill, with morning-market awnings below;
pairs.hanzi: 墙外能看见弯下去的路，路下面是早市棚顶，

pairs.target: zài wǎng xià , fángzi jǐ zài yìqǐ , yān xiàng yìcéng méiyǒu pūpíng de báobù .
pairs.english: farther down, houses crowded together, smoke like a sheet of thin cloth not quite smoothed flat.
pairs.hanzi: 再往下，房子挤在一起，烟像一层没有铺平的薄布。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng zhèlǐ jīngguò hǎo jǐcì , què dìyīcì rènzhēn zhǎo nàtiáo lù zěnyàng líkāi tóng jiē .
pairs.english: Tavi had passed here several times, but this was the first time he really looked for how that road left Copperstep.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从这里经过好几次，却第一次认真找那条路怎样离开铜阶。

pairs.target: tā zài wūdǐng zhījiān lùchū duǎnduǎn jǐjié , dào yuǎnchù hūrán bèi shān bèi dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: It showed in short stretches between roofs, then was suddenly hidden by a mountainside in the distance.
pairs.hanzi: 它在屋顶之间露出短短几截，到远处忽然被山背挡住。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào hòumiàn háiyǒu lù , yǎnjīng què bùnéng gēn guòqù .
pairs.english: He knew there was more road beyond, but his eyes could not follow it.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道后面还有路，眼睛却不能跟过去。

pairs.target: yígè bèi kōng kuāng de nǚrén tíng zài nài lěi shēnbiān , wèn tā shìbushì qù běi chà .
pairs.english: A woman carrying an empty basket on her back stopped beside Nerai and asked whether she was going to Northfork.
pairs.hanzi: 一个背空筐的女人停在奈蕾身边，问她是不是去北汊。

pairs.target: tā gē zài nàlǐ shōu yú , zhège yuè sònglái dehuà shuō shuǐqiǎn , chuán kào bùliǎo yuánlái de àn ,
pairs.english: Her brother bought fish there; word sent this month said the water was too shallow for boats to reach their old landing.
pairs.hanzi: 她哥在那里收鱼，这个月送来的话说水浅，船靠不了原来的岸，

alignment.english: too shallow for boats to reach

pairs.target: tā xiǎng tuōrén kànkàn jiūjìng huàn dào le nǎér .
pairs.english: She wanted someone to find out exactly where they had moved.
pairs.hanzi: 她想托人看看究竟换到了哪儿。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiào tā bǎ shōu yú de rén míng hé pùzi de jiù wèizhì shuō mànxiē .
pairs.english: Nerai asked her to give the fish buyer's name and the shop's old location slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾叫她把收鱼的人名和铺子的旧位置说慢些。

pairs.target: nǚrén yìbiān shuō yìbiān bǐhuà , tǎ wéi rènchū tā bǎi de shì shítáng wài nà jiā yānyú tān .
pairs.english: As the woman spoke and gestured, Tavi recognized her as the owner of the pickled-fish stall outside the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 女人一边说一边比画，塔维认出她摆的是食堂外那家腌鱼摊。

pairs.target: píngrì tā yāohe dé hěn xiǎng , zhèhuìer shuō dào gē de míngzì , dǎo pà nài lěi tīngbùqīng , lián zhuó zhòngfù le liǎngbiàn .
pairs.english: Usually she called her wares loudly, but now she feared Nerai might not hear her brother's name clearly and repeated it twice in succession.
pairs.hanzi: 平日她吆喝得很响，这会儿说到哥的名字，倒怕奈蕾听不清，连着重复了两遍。

pairs.target: " wǒ zǒu dédào jiù wèn . " nài lěi shuō , " búshì měi yíduàn dōu kào chuán . "
pairs.english: “I'll ask if I get there,” Nerai said. “Not every stretch is by boat.”
pairs.hanzi: “我走得到就问。”奈蕾说，“不是每一段都靠船。”

pairs.target: nǚrén shuō zhīdào , réng wǎng chē biān fàng le gè xiǎo zhǐbāo .
pairs.english: The woman said she knew, but still set a small paper packet beside the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 女人说知道，仍往车边放了个小纸包。

pairs.target: hè shīfu wén le yíxià , wèn shìbushì nàge xiándé néng jiào rén hē bàn héshuǐ de yú .
pairs.english: Master He sniffed it and asked whether it was that fish salty enough to make a person drink half a river.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅闻了一下，问是不是那个咸得能叫人喝半河水的鱼。

pairs.target: tā mà tā zuǐdiāo , xiào zhe zǒu le .
pairs.english: She called him fussy and walked away laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 她骂他嘴刁，笑着走了。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ gāng jìxià de xiǎo zhǐjiá jìn běnzi .
pairs.english: Nerai tucked the little note she had just made into her notebook.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把刚记下的小纸夹进本子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn bái pái cóng lǐngkǒu lùchū lái , sāndào héng hén bèi chénguāng zhào dé hěn qiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi saw the white tally showing at her collar, its three notches faint in the morning light.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见白牌从领口露出来，三道横痕被晨光照得很浅。

pairs.target: nǚrén yǐjīng zǒu yuǎn , hái huí le yícì tóu .
pairs.english: The woman was already far away when she looked back once more.
pairs.hanzi: 女人已经走远，还回了一次头。

pairs.target: huò píngshàng de rén bìng méiyǒu dōu tíngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Not everyone in the yard had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 货坪上的人并没有都停下来。

pairs.target: yíliàng méichē yào guò , gǎnchē rén jiào tāmen ràngkāi ; yǒurén zhuī zhe tǎo zuótiān jiè de shéng .
pairs.english: A coal cart needed to pass, and its driver called for them to move; someone was chasing a rope borrowed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 一辆煤车要过，赶车人叫他们让开；有人追着讨昨天借的绳。

pairs.target: kě tǎ wéi hūrán míngbái , nài lěi zǒuguò de nàxiē lù , huì gēnzhe tā dài huílái dehuà , yìzhí shēn dào zhèxiē tānzi hé ménkǒu .
pairs.english: But Tavi suddenly understood that the roads Nerai had traveled could extend, through the news she brought home, all the way to these stalls and doorways.
pairs.hanzi: 可塔维忽然明白，奈蕾走过的那些路，会跟着她带回来的话，一直伸到这些摊子和门口。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn tāmen shénme shíhòu huílái .
pairs.english: Mira asked when they would return.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问他们什么时候回来。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō àn xiànzài de xíngchéng , láihuí jiā hébiān tíngliú dàyuē sānzhōu ;
pairs.english: Nerai said the current itinerary allowed about three weeks for the journey out and back, including the stay at the river;
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说按现在的行程，来回加河边停留大约三周；

pairs.target: yǔshuǐ hé dùkǒu dōu dé kàn , dào shíhuì cóng néng dìxìn de zhàn sòng xiāoxī .
pairs.english: rain and crossings would have to be taken as they came, and she would send word from stations that could carry letters.
pairs.hanzi: 雨水和渡口都得看，到时会从能递信的站送消息。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn dìyīwǎn yào zhù de fāngxiàng , hái méi yuèguò zuìyuǎn nà dào shānjǐ .
pairs.english: She pointed out the direction of their first night's lodging: it was still this side of the farthest ridge.
pairs.hanzi: 她指给他们看第一晚要住的方向，还没越过最远那道山脊。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiǎngxiàng lǐ shìbushì jīntiān jiù néng zǒu dào dìtú wàitou ? " tā wèn tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: “Were you imagining we'd walk off the map today?” she asked Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: “你想象里是不是今天就能走到地图外头？”她问塔维。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng shuō méiyǒu , xiǎng le xiǎng , diǎntóu .
pairs.english: He meant to say no, thought for a moment, and nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 他本想说没有，想了想，点头。

pairs.target: " nà hè shīfu huì xiān bǎ wǒ gǎn xiàchē . tā wǎnfàn hái méi chī . "
pairs.english: “Master He would throw me off the cart first. He hasn't had dinner yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “那贺师傅会先把我赶下车。他晚饭还没吃。”

pairs.target: hè shīfu tīngjiàn zìjǐ de míngzì , wèn shuí yào tì tā fù fànqián .
pairs.english: Hearing his name, Master He asked who was paying for his meal.
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅听见自己的名字，问谁要替他付饭钱。

pairs.target: méi rén yìng tā , tā biàn bǎ shéng tóu jié hǎo , xuānbù zhè yìchē dōu shì lóngzǐ .
pairs.english: When nobody answered, he tied off the rope and declared the entire cartload deaf.
pairs.hanzi: 没人应他，他便把绳头结好，宣布这一车都是聋子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào wán , zhōngyú wènmíng nián néng bunéng gēnzhe chūqù .
pairs.english: After laughing, Tavi finally asked if he could go along next year.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑完，终于问明年能不能跟着出去。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō yídìng qù běi chà , yě méi shuō yào qù duō yuǎn ,
pairs.english: He didn't specify Northfork or how far he wanted to go.
pairs.hanzi: 他没说一定去北汊，也没说要去多远，

pairs.target: wèn chūkǒu cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ yìzhí zài děng yígè bǐ liànxí zuòdéhǎo gèng míngquè de dáfù .
pairs.english: Only after asking did he realize he had been waiting for an answer more definite than doing well in practice.
pairs.hanzi: 问出口才发现，自己一直在等一个比练习做得好更明确的答复。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu lìkè diǎntóu .
pairs.english: Nerai did not nod immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有立刻点头。

pairs.target: tā shuō xuégōng kāichūn yǒu lǎoshī dàiduì de jìn tú shí zuò , yào kàn jīchǔkè hé shíjì fēnzǔ ,
pairs.english: She said the academy ran nearby practical trips led by teachers in spring, subject to foundation classes and actual group assignments;
pairs.hanzi: 她说学宫开春有老师带队的近途实作，要看基础课和实际分组，

pairs.target: búshì tā zài chē páng yíjù huà jiù néng tiān rén .
pairs.english: she could not add someone with a word beside the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 不是她在车旁一句话就能添人。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . wǒ shì wèn , yǐhòu nǐ yuànbuyuànyì dài wǒ . "
pairs.english: “I know. I'm asking whether you'd want to take me someday.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。我是问，以后你愿不愿意带我。”

pairs.target: tā kàn le tā yíhuìer , bǎ zuǐjiǎo zhān zhe de bǐngxiè cādiào .
pairs.english: She watched him a moment and wiped the crumbs from the corner of her mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了他一会儿，把嘴角沾着的饼屑擦掉。

pairs.target: " yuànyì . " tā shuō , " děng yǒu héshì de huó , yě děng nǐ zhēn néng fēndān tā .
pairs.english: “Yes,” she said. “When there's suitable work and you can really share it.
pairs.hanzi: “愿意。”她说，“等有合适的活，也等你真能分担它。

pairs.target: dàoshíhòu kě bùxǔ bǎ zuì nán xiě de jìlù quánsāi gěi biérén . "
pairs.english: And you can't dump all the hardest records on someone else then.”
pairs.hanzi: 到时候可不许把最难写的记录全塞给别人。”

pairs.target: yīwén zài pángbiān jǔqǐ shǒu , shuō zìjǐ tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Iven raised a hand beside them and said he had heard that.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在旁边举起手，说自己听见了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuī le tā yíxià , tuī dé bú zhòng , xiōngkǒu què xiàng gāng tūnxià yídàkǒu rèshuǐ , nuǎn dé yǒudiǎn fāzhàng .
pairs.english: Tavi gave him a light shove, though his own chest felt as if he had swallowed a great mouthful of hot water, warm and almost swollen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维推了他一下，推得不重，胸口却像刚吞下一大口热水，暖得有点发胀。

pairs.target: tā háiyǒu xǔduō huà , zhēn dào yàoshuō shí , zhī wèn pījiān de guà shéngjié bu jiēshi .
pairs.english: He had so much else to say, but when the moment came he only asked if the cape's hanging loop was sturdy.
pairs.hanzi: 他还有许多话，真到要说时，只问披肩的挂绳结不结实。

alignment.english: if the cape's hanging loop was sturdy

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zuótiān guà le yíyè , méi diào .
pairs.english: Nerai said it had hung all night yesterday without falling.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说昨天挂了一夜，没掉。

pairs.target: tā līn qǐ pījiān , ràng tā kàn le yìyǎn nà jǐzhēn , suíhòu chuān shàng , kòuhǎo lǐngkǒu .
pairs.english: She lifted the cape to show him the stitches, then put it on and fastened the collar.
pairs.hanzi: 她拎起披肩，让他看了一眼那几针，随后穿上，扣好领口。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí chuīhào .
pairs.english: No one blew a horn.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁吹号。

pairs.target: chēfū shìleshì jiāngshéng , hè shīfu táishǒu jiào xíng , qiánmiàn de rén bǎ yìkuāng cài wǎng pángbiān nuó .
pairs.english: The driver tested the reins, Master He raised a hand for departure, and someone ahead moved a basket of vegetables aside.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫试了试缰绳，贺师傅抬手叫行，前面的人把一筐菜往旁边挪。

pairs.target: chēlún yā guò shífèng , tǎ wéi rènde de xiāng jiǎo huàng le yíxià , biàn bèi hè shīfu de xīgài dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: The wheels rolled over a crack in the stone. The box corner Tavi recognized jolted, then disappeared behind Master He's knee.
pairs.hanzi: 车轮压过石缝，塔维认得的箱角晃了一下，便被贺师傅的膝盖挡住。

pairs.target: nài lěi huítóu huīshǒu , jiào tāmen bié gǎnzhe xiàpō , dì yītángkè háiyào shàng .
pairs.english: Nerai turned and waved, telling them not to follow downhill: they still had their first class.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾回头挥手，叫他们别赶着下坡，第一堂课还要上。

pairs.target: sāngè rén liúzài shíqiáng biān .
pairs.english: The three stayed beside the stone wall.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人留在石墙边。

pairs.target: chēzi guǎijìn zǎoshì bèihòu , yòu cóng liǎngzuò wūzi zhōngjiān chūxiàn , yǐjīng xiǎo le bùshǎo .
pairs.english: The cart turned behind the morning market and reappeared between two houses, already much smaller.
pairs.hanzi: 车子拐进早市背后，又从两座屋子中间出现，已经小了不少。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìzhí kàndào tā zài zhuǎnwān , cái fāxiàn mǐlā de shǒu dā zài tā de běnzi shàng , tì tā dǎng zhe qiángtóu dīxiàlái de shuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi watched until it turned again, then noticed Mira's hand over his notebook, shielding it from water dripping off the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一直看到它再转弯，才发现米拉的手搭在他的本子上，替他挡着墙头滴下来的水。

pairs.target: xuégōng nàbiān qiāo le zhōng . yīwén shuō xiànzài kāishǐ zǒu , cái búsuàn táokè .
pairs.english: The academy bell rang. Iven said they had to start walking now if it wasn't to count as skipping class.
pairs.hanzi: 学宫那边敲了钟。伊文说现在开始走，才不算逃课。

pairs.target: tāmen zhuǎnshēn shàngpō , tǎ wéi zǒu le jǐbù yòu huítóu , lùshang yǐjīng huànchéng yíliàng lā cài de chē .
pairs.english: They turned uphill. Tavi looked back after a few steps, but a vegetable cart had taken its place on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 他们转身上坡，塔维走了几步又回头，路上已经换成一辆拉菜的车。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn wǔhòu hái zuò bu zuò zhǎntái shàng de shuōmíng pái .
pairs.english: Mira asked whether they were still making the display label that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问午后还做不做展台上的说明牌。

pairs.target: xiǎo zhǎn dìng zài sìtiān hòu , qiáo néngdòng le , zì hái méi xiě wán .
pairs.english: The exhibition was set for four days later; the bridge worked, but its lettering was not finished.
pairs.hanzi: 小展定在四天后，桥能动了，字还没写完。

pairs.english: “Yes,” he said. “I'll write it first this time, then you can look.”
